# A unified map that already exists in the new graph becomes a forwarding
# intersection, which the rewrite removes with a second, remapping pass.
builder
prim i integer
str s unrestricted
map m i in=existing
obj o1 a:i i n=O1
obj o2 b:i i n=O2
cls top m:m,o1:o1,o2:o2 n=Top
top Top top
finish printonrewrite
print
unify 3,4 debug
print
